human_request: 帮我做额外一轮验证。提取PTE5个虚拟账户的观察窗口，用新版本策略回放该窗口并观察决策与PTE账户历史是否严格一致。
scope: Read-only production evidence extraction and local offline replay; no alpha selection, source correction, PTE deployment or account changes.

method.portfolio: Actual historical account cash, quantity, total_assets and cycle state; independently reconstruct missing fields and authenticate recorded revisions where present.
method.full_chain: Original pinned input binding and preparation, new authenticated release, public SRT prepare_data and PTE get_decision, exact business values with zero numeric tolerance.
method.component: Explicitly separate authenticated historical input-table replay of the new formula and execution-plan components when the current data-admission contract cannot consume old preparation evidence. Does not count as full-chain PASS.
method.identities: Retain and separately report content-derived release/runtime/plan/signal/preparation/decision identities that necessarily change with implementation.
method.unavailable: Do not substitute later market data for missing original inputs or count absent fields as verified.
method.status: Compare all stored decisions including completed, superseded and incomplete; report each state separately.
method.scope_limit: Decision reproduction uses historical actual account feedback. It does not claim simulated fills reproduce broker fills or returns.
